# Your personal CraftBot, always online.

Skip the VPS, the Python envs, the babysitting. CraftBot Live runs an isolated, persistent CraftBot instance in the cloud for you — manage it from one dashboard, anywhere.

## All CraftBot, one dashboard.

Your personal assistant, research bot, market watcher — each in its own isolated cloud instance managed from a single dashboard. No SSH, no Docker, no juggling terminals.

## Not a chatbot. An agent that turns your instructions into results.

CraftBot controls a PC to perform any computer-based task for you. It remembers what you told it, proactively creates tasks, and runs them while you sleep.

## CraftBot builds, evolves, and operates its own tools.

Apps, dashboards, internal tools, software — CraftBot generates or imports them inside itself and operates them for the next level of automation.

### Generate from a sentence

"Build me a CRM for outreach" — CraftBot scaffolds the schema, API, and UI, then runs it.

Moved 'Q4 brief — Nova Foods' to In Progress. Added subtask: gather brand assets from Drive.

## Everything CraftBot does, hosted for you.

CraftBot Live host your open CraftBot agent runtime, managed end-to-end so you don't have to.

### One-click power on/off

Spin a CraftBot up in seconds, hibernate it when idle. No Docker, no SSH, no Python envs.

### Persistent S3 workspace

Your agent's memory, files, and learned skills live in isolated S3 buckets — durable across restarts.

### Always-on, anywhere

Your CraftBot keeps working even when your laptop is closed. Reach it from the dashboard, on any device.

### Isolated by default

Each instance runs in its own sandbox. We never touch your data outside the workspace you provision.

### Live metrics & logs

Token usage, compute time, requests per hour — all surfaced in the dashboard with no setup.

### Built on CraftBot

Same agent runtime as the open-source CraftBot — local skills, MCP servers, Living UI, all work as-is.
